EXERCISE — FICTIONAL

1. Synthetic aperture imagery of the Ostrand Peninsula shows that fishing vessel Ekhaven AIS gap of 9 hours; subsequently attributed to transponder failure.

2. Entities identified in this reporting: Ekhaven.

3. Ground disturbance consistent with recent heavy vehicle movement is visible across approximately 30 per cent of the apron.

4. Comparison against imagery of 7 days earlier shows 5 additional objects present and no objects removed.

5. The observed dispersal pattern is consistent with, but not diagnostic of, preparation for movement.

6. A single collection cannot distinguish preparation for movement from preparation for maintenance.
